findings: Source deterministically attributed persistent fatigue to thoracolumbar alignment, neurovascular compression, microcirculation, ATP and immune-neuroendocrine dysfunction, then extended these claims to SART and herbal delivery.

The 2024 spinal-manipulation systematic review included 14 trials and 618 participants; overall low-quality evidence found no change in autonomic measures and did not test chronic fatigue, microcirculation, immunity, ATP or Bodyall SART.

The 2021 Hochuekkito/Bojungikgi-tang paper reviewed basic pharmacology and heterogeneous infectious, inflammatory and frailty contexts; it does not establish ME/CFS efficacy, ATP restoration or synergy with thoracolumbar correction.
CDC states there is no single confirmatory ME/CFS test and diagnosis requires history, examination, targeted tests and exclusion of other fatiguing illnesses.
The mechanism image was removed; the hero image remains with reserved 1376x768 dimensions.
